INSERT INTO analysis_report_checklist_items ( analysis_report_checklist_id, checklist_item_id, is_checked )
SELECT #{reportChecklistId}, ci.checklist_item_id,
CASE WHEN arcr.is_verified = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
FROM checklist_items ci
LEFT JOIN analysis_report_checklist_results arcr ON arcr.analysis_report_id = #{analysisReportId} AND arcr.checklist_item_id = ci.checklist_item_id
WHERE ci.category = 'COMMON' OR ci.category = #{category}
OR ci.category = 'TRUST_PROPERTY'
mapper.select:
SELECT ar.analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, arc.analysis_report_checklist_id AS reportChecklistId, ar.housing_category AS housingCategory, ar.is_trust_property AS trustProperty, ar.road_address AS roadAddress, ar.detail_address AS detailAddress, ar.risk_level AS riskLevel,
CASE WHEN arc.analysis_report_checklist_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS checklistCreated,
COALESCE(progress.checked_count, 0) AS checkedCount,
COALESCE(progress.total_count, 0) AS totalCount,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(progress.total_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE ROUND( progress.checked_count * 100.0 / progress.total_count ) END AS progressPercentage,
ar.created_at AS reportCreatedAt
FROM analysis_reports ar
LEFT JOIN analysis_report_checklists arc ON arc.analysis_report_id = ar.analysis_report_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT analysis_report_checklist_id,
COUNT(*) AS total_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN is_checked = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS checked_count
FROM analysis_report_checklist_items
GROUP BY analysis_report_checklist_id
) progress ON progress.analysis_report_checklist_id = arc.analysis_report_checklist_id
WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId}
ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.analysis_report_id DESC

SELECT ci.checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, ci.contents AS contents, ci.description AS description, ci.category AS category, arci.is_checked AS checked
FROM analysis_report_checklist_items arci
INNER JOIN analysis_report_checklists arc ON arc.analysis_report_checklist_id = arci.analysis_report_checklist_id
INNER JOIN checklist_items ci ON ci.checklist_item_id = arci.checklist_item_id
WHERE arc.analysis_report_checklist_id = #{reportChecklistId}
AND arc.account_id = #{accountId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ci.category = 'COMMON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ci.checklist_item_id ASC
